title: Analysis code for migrasome-related genes in ulcerative colitis
description: Analysis code for bulk transcriptome, single-cell transcriptome, GWAS summary statistics, and spatial transcriptome analyses of migrasome-related genes in ulcerative colitis. The repository contains the analysis scripts, environment records, and documentation. Raw data are available from GEO (GSE87466, GSE75214, GSE214695, GSE189184) and OpenGWAS (ieu-a-32).
